data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'gharasa', meaning to be generous or bestow blessings. In Islamic tradition, Gharisah is a name for a woman who embodies grace and kindness. The name Gharisah carries the meaning “Gentle, Gracious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Gharisah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
